uutiset.t: Ukrainian FA to blame for failed drugs test - Mudryk
uutiset.s: Tottenham's on-loan Chelsea winger Mykhailo Mudryk says he blames the Ukrainian Association of Football for his failed drugs test and subsequent ban.

uutiset.t: Bottas' stay at Cadillac confirmed for 2027
uutiset.s: Valtteri Bottas is retained by Cadillac for the 2027 Formula 1 season.

uutiset.t: England defender Carter joins Bay FC after Gotham exit
uutiset.s: England defender Jess Carter completes a move to Bay FC after leaving Gotham FC as a free agent.

uutiset.t: Strasbourg announce appointment of Swans boss Matos
uutiset.s: Strasbourg appoint Swansea City's Vitor Matos as the club's new head coach.

uutiset.t: FA explored legal challenge to Infantino staying on
uutiset.s: The Football Association considered challenging Gianni Infantino's eligibility to run for a fourth term as Fifa president, but it felt a case was likely to fail.

uutiset.t: Hemp and Shaw star as Manchester City get vital win at Hacken
uutiset.s: Substitutes Lauren Hemp and Khadija Shaw both get on the scoresheet to help Manchester City secure a crucial 2-0 win against Swedish side Hacken in the Champions League.

uutiset.t: McClenaghan's coach Carson leaves high performance role
uutiset.s: Luke Carson, who helped guide Rhys McClenaghan to Olympic gold in 2024, has stepped away from high performance coaching.

uutiset.t: Leicester split with sponsor after porn actress row
uutiset.s: A fans group had complained after BC Game appointed a porn actress as a brand ambassador.

uutiset.t: From kit boy to manager at 28 - Dumbarton appoint Fellowes
uutiset.s: Martin Fellowes becomes the youngest manager in SPFL history, taking on the Dumbarton job at the age of 28.

uutiset.t: Ward close to new Republic of Ireland deal as Noonan returns
uutiset.s: Republic of Ireland manager Carla Ward says she is close to agreeing a new contract as she names her squad for the World Cup play-off final.

uutiset.t: All Blacks nightmare was making of me - Van Poortvliet
uutiset.s: Jack van Poortvliet was picked off and subbed off when he last met the All Blacks. Four years on, he says the experience made him a better player.

uutiset.t: Rees-Zammit: From beating All Blacks to meeting Man Utd heroes
uutiset.s: Louis Rees-Zammit has had a week to remember having helped Wales to a historic win over New Zealand and meeting his Manchester United heroes.

uutiset.t: Prem opens registration for expansion to 12 teams
uutiset.s: Prem Rugby opens a registration process for teams to apply with the aim of expanding the league to 12 clubs for the 2029-30 season.

uutiset.t: Watch: Non-league player scores from own half
uutiset.s: The midfielder speaks of his "special moment" as fans roared from around the ground.

uutiset.t: Zverev to defend himself against fresh lawsuit
uutiset.s: Lawyers for world number one Alexander Zverev say he will defend himself against a lawsuit which alleges he misrepresented the outcome of a domestic abuse trial.
